title: L⁴ Strichartz on a cube
plain: On a flat square torus the L⁴ Strichartz estimate holds with only ε loss of derivatives. Prove the same on the surface of a cube, where corners diffract waves.
math: Let $S$ be the flat unit-cube surface. Prove that for every $\varepsilon>0$, $\|e^{it\Delta}f\|_{L^4([0,1]\times S)}\le C_\varepsilon\|f\|_{H^\varepsilon(S)}$.
